name: jezero_delta
source: fused from: crism, ctx_dtm, hirise_dtm, hirise_ortho, hrsc_mola, mola, tes_albedo, themis, themis_ti | rock_abundance = texture proxy; science_score = CRISM minerals
grid_convention: layer[row, col]; row 0 = north, col 0 = west; points are (x_m east, y_m south) from NW corner

roughness.meaning: Local relief (std of elevation in a small window)

rock_abundance.meaning: Fraction of area covered by rocks

science_score.meaning: How interesting the spot is for the mission goals

nodata.meaning: True where real data is missing
